digest.component_or_area: LLM model class configuration and resolution
propositions: Rebar lacks a schema and resolver to express which model to use for each of three capability tiers (frontier, standard, trivial) across per-pass decisions, with all per-tier configuration routed through existing layered config (CLI -c > env > file > default)

A new model_classes.py module must define slots for frontier/standard/trivial tiers, each accepting model/provider/endpoint and optional non-recursive fallback array; validate that no slot or fallback entry contains api_key (secrets boundary); infer provider via existing infer_provider when omitted; and expose a load_class_slots() entry point that reads the real config table and returns resolved provider-qualified model strings

The three class slots must resolve to documented defaults (claude-opus-4-8/claude-sonnet-4-6/claude-haiku-4-5 respectively) when unset, preserving bit-for-bit compatibility with today's release and providing a rollback story

Environment variable overrides must address individual slot fields via nine distinct REBAR_LLM_<tier>_<field> vars (FRONTIER_MODEL, FRONTIER_PROVIDER, FRONTIER_ENDPOINT, and equivalents for STANDARD and TRIVIAL) while preserving per-key precedence rules, and fallback must remain config-file-only until sibling task cb6f delivers REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE
docs/env-vars.md must be regenerated and committed to show all nine new env vars, such that re-running the generator afterwards produces no diff

A fallback entry must be a provider target with model (required), provider (optional), and endpoint (optional), FORBIDDEN api_key, and NON-RECURSIVE (no nested fallback), validated at parse time and carried on the resolved record without runtime consumption
